page.notes: The first glyph of the first line and the two "V." references are a special abbreviation sign (possibly ꝟ or V with a stroke); read as V̄ with doubt. "prætium", "viam" and "projce" are uncertain (the ligature and missing dot are hard to see). Printed "Marc. 1. 2." is read with the Arabic 1, but the letter could be a lowercase i. Lowercase Roman numerals in references are kept as printed. Page numbers 80, 89, 94, 108, 118, 138, 144 and 150 sit at the right of their entries. The "Digitized by Google" watermark is excluded.
